Dialogue_Text: "The petite necromancer waded through the mud. He had but one goal: to bring back his dead kin, xvarts that had fallen during the infamous Battle on Graveyard. His plan was simple: to enchant the soil with the power of necromancy, and let undeath fill the rotting flesh of his dead brothers and sisters. But the necromancer didn't know there was a group of scouts patrolling the graveyard grounds."

A xvart necromancer? Bah! Such a worthless creature should have never been allowed to use such power! (These pathetic things will never understand it's for potent minds—like that of Edwin Odesseiron.)
If you want to face these enemies, face the necromancer, you should prepare yourself for dark magic. Oh, and you should also prepare 3,500 gold pieces.
No. I'll pass. At least for now.
Thank you. Try not to die, my friend.
